summary: Comprehensive testing of SoloLink (link-in-bio app). Backend pytest suite (21 tests) covering auth, profile, links CRUD, reorder, ownership 403, public profile and case-insensitive usernames — all pass. Frontend Playwright flows covering signup->dashboard, profile edit persistence, invalid URL rejection, empty title rejection, link add/reorder/delete, public profile without login, not-found claim CTA, multi-user ownership isolation and data persistence across logout/login — all pass. One Playwright assertion timed-out (User B empty state) but manual screenshot confirms UI correctness; the timing was a test-side issue, not an app bug.
critical_code_review_comments: Consider adding server-side rate limiting on /auth/check-username to prevent enumeration/DoS.

normalize_and_validate_url auto-prepends https:// to any string without scheme; this means truly invalid strings like 'not a url' with a space are correctly rejected because urlparse().netloc lacks a '.', but single-word inputs like 'foo' would also be rejected (good). Behavior is acceptable but worth documenting.
Public profile endpoint returns display_name fallback to username — good. Ownership checks are consistent and correct (compare link.user_id to str(user._id)).
Server currently keeps a module-level storage_key; concurrent avatar uploads on a stale key trigger a single re-init which is fine, but consider using a lock to avoid races.
No explicit 'PATCH avatar delete' endpoint — not required by spec.
server.py is a single 427-line file — still under 700 lines; fine for MVP but split into routers if extending.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional (10/11 automated PASS + 1 test-timing false negative confirmed working via screenshot)

test_credentials: Dynamic per-run: ui_a_<ts>@example.com / password123 and ui_b_<ts>@example.com / password123. Suggested static: tharun@example.com / password123, alex@example.com / password123 (create via signup).
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates 2 users with random suffix (test_a_<hex>, test_b_<hex>) and a handful of links. Not cleaned up; harmless in preview DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — self-contained, uses random suffixes, safe to re-run. Public profile route is /:username at root level; signup live-check uses /api/auth/check-username with 400ms debounce. User B's empty-state assertion in Playwright needs a wait_for_selector on [data-testid=links-empty-state] to avoid the loader race.
